head: b05f3e2cdbccdc6a04e8b800c00e26bf80f16110
governing_instruction: Do not add or retain compatibility shims, legacy aliases, migrations, old-shape detection or rejection, fallback paths, dual behavior, or stale overrides; breaking cleanup is required.
scope: Final bounded re-review of R04 only. No new security or hypothetical edge-case review was performed.

evidence.requirement: Child-time and control idle require canonical game ABSENT, process ABSENT and a complete scan; incomplete evidence preserves ownership.
evidence.assessment: _child_time_current_game returns unavailable for missing game/process objects, malformed running_games and PENDING/UNAVAILABLE evidence. It returns idle only for game state idle with game evidence ABSENT, process evidence ABSENT, no game id and running_scan_status complete. _control_reconcile_idle_locked independently requires the same canonical evidence plus an empty running_games list before clearing stream ownership. The lost-close test now supplies a real canonical idle observation.

evidence.requirement: Provider /health is removed and /observation is the sole lifecycle/readiness observation path.
evidence.assessment: The Provider GET router contains library, artwork, observation and events only; /health falls through to 404. The route contract test asserts /health=404 and /observation=200 with current schema evidence.

evidence.requirement: Gateway capabilities, profile summaries and child-profile projection do not call game_provider /health.
evidence.assessment: Parent capabilities and profile projections call game_provider /observation and derive connector availability from provider.connector_evidence. Child capabilities return the bounded protocol projection without probing parent integrations. Tests assert the observation call and absence of any game_provider /health call.

evidence.requirement: The TypeError old-caller retry, migrated gameId alias and string broker-field fallback are removed.
evidence.assessment: Child profile availability uses only the current profile_id-aware proxy signature with no TypeError retry. The migrated observation consumer reads only canonical game_id. LoginBroker child-profile response decoding reads integer field 3 only; the binary broker test confirms integer-key decoding.

evidence.requirement: Documentation and tests describe the canonical observation-only contract.
evidence.assessment: Documentation points to /observation and no longer advertises the removed Playnite health/current/readiness routes. HTTP tests cover the shared parent/child observation read and 404 responses for the old public routes.

finding_dispositions.ux_stability_assessment: PENDING, UNAVAILABLE or malformed Provider observations no longer masquerade as idle, so child terminal/restart and retained control ownership stay fenced until explicit absence is proven. Canonical ABSENT observations still permit deterministic lost-response recovery without issuing a duplicate close.

verification.interpretation: The provided full-suite and packet results cover the reviewed fingerprint and support the code-level closure evidence.

notes: No P0-P3 blocker remains in the bounded R04 closure scope.
The prior R04 residuals are resolved without a compatibility shim, legacy alias, fallback path or dual endpoint behavior.
No production or test source file was edited; this requested review artifact is the only updated file.
